name: Ridge margin, home-win probability
preregistered_hypothesis: Opponent-adjusted margin ratings carry more information about a fixture than a win-loss record does.
inputs_used: official game margins only (W1-W10), ridge fit, HFA estimated
what_would_change_our_mind: if the game-cluster lower bound on skill stays at or below zero across two further months of graded games, the rating signal is not real and the model should be replaced by the constant
what_would_make_us_double_down: skill lower bound above zero with n>=100 and calibration gap <= 0.05: then the rule is promoted to the reference model for the division, not to live staking
ranking_basis: benchmark-relative proper score with a game-cluster lower bound and a Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment; never win rate, never season-long ROI
